items.title: A variant of the local criterion for flatness via Tor one and the quotient by an ideal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file algebra.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that for a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings, a finite module with vanishing Tor one against the quotient by an ideal and flat quotient along that ideal is flat over the base (statement lines 23967-23973). The proof gives two arguments: one reduces to the vanishing of Tor one against the residue field via the previous criterion, the other reinterprets the hypothesis as injectivity of the map from the ideal tensored with the module (proof lines 23975-24015). Recognising the hypothesis as an injectivity statement is what makes the second argument possible. H2.
